title: Workable integration (ATS & HRMS) | Xobin
text:
About Workable
Workable is a hiring platform that combines job advertising, applicant tracking and candidate sourcing. It helps teams publish roles across job boards, manage applicants through configurable workflows and collaborate on hiring decisions.
Why Integrate Workable with Xobin?
Integrating Workable with Xobin combines Workable's applicant tracking system with Xobin's skill assessment platform. You can invite candidates for assessments, monitor their progress and access detailed reports, all within Workable. It removes manual effort, improves evaluation accuracy and enables data-driven hiring decisions.

Who Is This Integration For?
This integration is designed for HR professionals, recruiters and talent acquisition teams using Workable for applicant tracking. It is ideal for organisations that want to automate candidate assessments, improve hiring accuracy and make informed decisions effortlessly inside Workable's existing workflow.
Capabilities
Features & benefits
Assessment provider setup
Paste the Xobin API key under Workable Settings > Integrations > Apps > Assessment Providers to connect in one step.
Per-job assessment mapping
Attach the right Xobin test to each role from the job's Workflow > Assessment section.
Timeline tracking
Invites appear under Pending Assessments and move to Submitted Assessments with the score once the candidate finishes.
Integrity and proctoring score
Every submission carries an integrity score alongside performance so you can judge test authenticity.
Consistent evaluation per role
Every applicant for a job takes the same mapped assessment, keeping evaluation fair and comparable.
Fewer unqualified interviews
Scores land on the Workable timeline before scheduling, so interview slots go to proven candidates.
